en.t: A papal election begins, resulting in the election of Pope Boniface I
en.s: Pope Boniface I (Latin: Bonifatius I; 4 September 422) was the bishop of Rome from 28 December 418 to his death on 4 September 422. His election was disputed by the supporters of Eulalius until the dispute was settled by Emperor Honorius. Boniface was active in maintaining church discipline, and he restored certain privileges to the metropolitical sees of Narbonne and Vienne, exempting them from any subjection to the primacy of Arles.

zh.t: 博尼法爵一世当选教宗
zh.s: 418年12月28日，博尼法爵一世当选罗马主教。他的当选受到尤拉利乌斯支持者反对，直到皇帝霍诺留出面才解决争议。博尼法爵在任期间维护教会纪律，并恢复纳博讷和维埃纳教区的部分权利。

en.t: Alaric II succeeds his father Euric and becomes king of the Visigoths. He establishes his capital at Aire-sur-l'Adour (Southern Gaul)
en.s: Alaric II (Gothic: 𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃, romanized: Alarīks, lit. 'ruler of all'; Latin: Alaricus; c. 458/466 – August 507) was the King of the Visigoths from 484 until his death. He succeeded his father Euric as King of the Visigoths in Toulouse on 28 December 484; he was the great-grandson of the more famous Alaric I, who sacked Rome in 410. He established his capital at Aire-sur-l'Adour (Vicus Julii) in Aquitaine.

zh.s: 阿拉里克二世（哥特语：𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃，转写：Alarīks，意为“众人之主”；拉丁语：Alaricus；约458/466年—507年8月）自484年至去世一直担任西哥特国王。公元484年12月28日，他在图卢兹继承父亲欧里克成为西哥特国王。他是更著名的阿拉里克一世（410年洗劫罗马）的曾孙。他将首都设在阿基坦的艾尔河畔阿杜尔（Vicus Julii）。

en.s: The 893 Dvin earthquake occurred on 28 December 893 at around midnight. It had a magnitude of approximately 6 and a maximum intensity of approximately IX (Violent) on the Mercalli intensity scale. It destroyed the city of Dvin in Armenia, causing approximately 30,000 casualties. The earthquake is sometimes referred to as the 893 Ardabil earthquake. Although the 893 Ardabil earthquake appears in several catalogues the event may not have happened.

zh.s: 893年德温地震发生于当年12月28日午夜前后，震级约6级，麦加利地震烈度约为IX级（猛烈）。地震摧毁亚美尼亚的德温城，造成约3万人伤亡。该地震有时被称为893年阿尔达比勒地震。虽然多个地震目录收录了893年阿尔达比勒地震，但这次地震可能并未发生。

en.t: Edward the Confessor's Romanesque monastic church at Westminster Abbey is consecrated
en.s: Edward the Confessor (1003/1005 – 5 January 1066) was King of the English from 1042 until his death in 1066. He was the last reigning monarch of the House of Wessex. Edward was the son of Æthelred the Unready and Emma of Normandy. He succeeded Cnut the Great's son – and his own half-brother – Harthacnut.

zh.t: 威斯敏斯特修道院内罗曼式教堂祝圣
zh.s: 1065年12月28日，威斯敏斯特修道院内的罗曼式修道教堂举行祝圣仪式。英格兰国王忏悔者爱德华于1042年至1066年在位，是韦塞克斯王朝最后一位在位君主。

en.s: The Battle of Slioch was a minor skirmish in the First War of Scottish Independence. Although the encounter was inconclusive, the domestic enemies of the Scottish King Robert Bruce were unable to stop him from consolidating his rule over Scotland.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯利奥克战役是第一次苏格兰独立战争期间的一场小规模冲突。战斗没有明确结果，但苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯在苏格兰国内的敌人未能阻止他巩固统治。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: In the Battle of Giornico, also known as the battle of large rocks (Italian: Battaglia di Giornico, dei Sassi Grossi; German: Schlacht bei Giornico) (28 December 1478), about 600 Swiss troops ambushed from above and defeated a larger force of the Duchy of Milan, confined in a narrow icy valley, by rolling large boulders down the hillside against the Milanese.

zh.s: 1478年12月28日，约600名瑞士士兵在冰封狭窄的山谷中，从高处伏击米兰公国人数更多的军队。他们将巨石从山坡滚下，击败了米兰军队。这场战役也称“大石之战”。

en.s: The siege of Jailolo (1550–1551) was a successful military expedition launched by Bernaldim de Sousa, a Portuguese commander, against the Sultan of Jailolo, supported by the Sultan of Ternate and the Prince of Batjan, lasting three months.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 葡萄牙指挥官贝尔纳迪姆·德索萨率军，联合特尔纳特苏丹和巴占王子，围攻贾伊洛洛苏丹控制的城池。围城于1550年12月28日开始，持续约三个月，于1551年以葡萄牙及其盟友取胜告终。
zh.n: 围城于1550年12月28日开始。

en.s: Battle of Kolhapur was a land battle that took place on December 28, 1659 near the city of Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India between the Maratha Chhatrapati Shivaji. The battle is known for brilliant movement of flanks by Shivaji similar to Uzbek tactics of Babur against Rana Sangha.

zh.s: 科尔哈布尔战役是1659年12月28日发生于印度马哈拉施特拉邦科尔哈布尔附近的一场陆战，交战双方包括马拉塔王公希瓦吉。希瓦吉巧妙地从侧翼机动，类似巴布尔对阵拉纳·桑加时采用的乌兹别克战术。

en.s: The Thonburi Kingdom was a major Siamese kingdom which existed in Southeast Asia from 1767 to 1782, centred on the city of Thonburi, in Siam or present-day Thailand. The kingdom was founded by Taksin, who reunited Siam following the collapse of the Ayutthaya Kingdom, which saw the country separate into five warring regional states.

zh.s: 1767年12月28日，达信在阿瑜陀耶王朝灭亡、暹罗分裂为五个交战地区后重新统一暹罗，并建立了以吞武里为中心的王朝。吞武里王朝延续至1782年。

en.s: The Capture of St Lucia was the result of a campaign from 18–28 December 1778 by British land and naval forces to take over the island, which was a French colony. Britain's actions followed the capture of the British-controlled island of Dominica by French forces in a surprise invasion in September 1778. During the Battle of St. Lucia, the British fleet defeated a French fleet sent to reinforce the island.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1778年12月18日至28日，英国陆海军发起战役，占领当时属于法国殖民地的圣卢西亚岛。此前，法国军队于同年9月突然入侵并占领英国控制的多米尼克岛。在圣卢西亚战役中，英国舰队击败了前来增援该岛的法国舰队。
zh.n: 战役于1778年12月28日结束。

en.s: The Battle of Nedumkotta took place between December 1789 and May 1790, and was a reason for the opening of hostilities in the Third Anglo-Mysore War. This battle was fought between Tipu Sultan of the Kingdom of Mysore and Dharma Raja, Maharaja of Travancore. Mysore army attacked the fortified line in Thrissur district at the Travancore border known as the Nedumkotta.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 内杜姆科塔战役于1789年12月28日开始，持续至1790年5月，是第三次英迈索尔战争爆发的原因之一。迈索尔王国蒂普苏丹的军队与特拉凡哥尔大君达摩·拉贾交战，并攻打特里苏尔地区、位于特拉凡哥尔边界的内杜姆科塔防线。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的战役开始日期。

en.s: The Bathurst War (1824) was a war in present-day New South Wales, Australia, between the Wiradjuri tribes and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. The successful Blaxland, Lawson, and Wentworth expedition of 1813 to find a route through the "impenetrable" Blue Mountains allowed the colony to expand onto the vast fertile plains of the west.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 温德拉丁率族人赴总督宴会
zh.s: 1824年12月28日，温德拉丁率领族人来到帕拉马塔，出席新南威尔士总督的年度宴会。他在帽子上写着“和平”；英国当局担心逮捕他会引发骚乱，因此没有动手。此前，殖民政府已于12月11日废除戒严令。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的战争结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Nanggulon was an engagement in the Java War between the Dutch colonial forces and rebel forces of Prince Diponegoro, commanded by Sentot Prawirodirdjo, which took place on 28 December 1828. The rebel forces launched an attack on a Dutch detachment close to a newly constructed Dutch fortification, inflicting heavy casualties before being repulsed by another unit.

zh.s: 1828年12月28日，爪哇战争期间，迪波内戈罗王子麾下由森托特·普拉维罗迪尔佐指挥的反叛军袭击了荷兰殖民军一支分队。战斗发生在新建荷兰工事附近，反叛军造成对方重大伤亡，但随后被另一支部队击退。

en.s: The USS Lexington raid on the Falkland Islands was a United States naval action against the settlement at Puerto Luis between December 28, 1831, and January 22, 1832. It followed the seizure of three American sealing vessels by forces acting under Luis Vernet, whom the government of Buenos Aires had appointed political and military commander of the islands in 1829.

zh.s: 美国海军“列克星敦”号于1831年12月28日至1832年1月22日袭击福克兰群岛的路易港聚落。此前，路易斯·韦尔内麾下人员扣押了3艘美国捕海豹船；韦尔内于1829年获布宜诺斯艾利斯政府任命，担任群岛军政长官。
zh.n: 远征行动于1831年12月28日开始，持续至1832年1月22日。

en.t: John C. Calhoun becomes the first Vice President of the United States to resign. He resigned after being elected Senator from South Carolina
en.s: John Caldwell Calhoun (; March 18, 1782 – March 31, 1850) was an American statesman and political theorist who served as the seventh vice president of the United States from 1825 to 1832. Calhoun began his political career as a nationalist, modernizer and proponent of a strong federal government and protective tariffs.

zh.t: 约翰·C. 卡尔霍恩当选南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员后辞去副总统职务，成为首位辞职的美国副总统
zh.s: 约翰·考德威尔·卡尔霍恩（1782年3月18日—1850年3月31日）是美国政治家和政治理论家，1825年至1832年担任美国第七任副总统。他的政治生涯始于民族主义者、现代化改革者以及联邦强政府和保护性关税的支持者。

en.s: The Dade battle (often called the Dade massacre) was an 1835 military defeat for the United States Army. Under the Indian Removal Act of 1830 the U.S. was attempting to force the Seminoles to move away from their land in Florida provided by the Treaty of Moultrie Creek (following the American annexation of Spanish Florida see the Adams-Onis Treaty) and relocate to Indian Territory under the terms of the Treaty of Payne's Landing.

zh.s: 1835年12月28日，佛罗里达的塞米诺尔战士伏击了美国陆军一支部队。士兵经过5天行军，刚走到今布什内尔以南时，一声枪响拉开战斗；塞米诺尔首领米卡诺皮打响第一枪，戴德少校和接任指挥的乔治·加德纳上尉均被杀。

en.t: The commencement of colonial government was proclaimed on 28 December 1836, now known as Proclamation Day
en.s: South Australia (commonly abbreviated as SA) is a state in the southern central part of Australia. With a total land area of 984,314 square kilometres (380,046 sq mi), it is the fourth-largest of Australia's states and territories by area, which includes some of the most arid parts of the continent. It is the 17th-largest subdivision in the world and the fifth-largest in Australasia.

zh.t: 南澳殖民政府开始运作
zh.s: 南澳大利亚州（简称SA）位于澳大利亚中南部，陆地总面积984,314平方公里（380,046平方英里），是澳大利亚面积第四大的州和领地，其中包括澳洲大陆一些最干旱的地区。按面积计算，它是全球第17大一级行政区，也是大洋洲第五大一级行政区。

en.s: The 1855 New Zealand general election was a nationwide vote to determine the shape of the New Zealand Parliament's 2nd term. It was the second national election ever held in New Zealand, and the first one which elected a Parliament that had full authority to govern the colony.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1855年新西兰大选用于选出第二届新西兰议会。投票从10月26日开始，各选区在不同日期投票，最后一个席位于12月28日选出。这是新西兰第二次全国大选，也是首次选出拥有完整执政权限的议会；全体37个议席均需改选。
zh.n: 投票于1855年10月26日开始，最后一个席位于12月28日选出。

en.s: The Battle of Canton (Chinese: 廣州城戰役) was fought by British and French forces against Qing China on 28–31 December 1857 during the Second Opium War. The British High Commissioner, Lord Elgin, was keen to take the city of Canton (Guangzhou) as a demonstration of power and to capture Chinese official Ye Mingchen, who had resisted British attempts to implement the 1842 Treaty of Nanking.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次鸦片战争期间，英法联军于1857年12月28日至31日进攻清朝广州。英国高级专员额尔金勋爵希望以夺取广州展示实力，并抓获拒绝落实《南京条约》的清朝官员叶名琛。
zh.n: 战役于1857年12月28日开始，持续至31日。

en.s: The Battle of Sacramento was an engagement of the American Civil War that took place in Sacramento, Kentucky on December 28, 1861. Confederate cavalry under Colonel Nathan Bedford Forrest, numbering between 200 and 300, attacked, encircled and defeated a Union force of 500 under Major Eli H. Murray which had been watering south of the town after moving across the bank of the Green River. Though exact casualty information is disputed, with differing accounts from each side, several eyewitnesses attested to the personal courage of Forrest, and the Confederate commander was praised by his superiors for his bravery.

zh.t: 萨克拉门托战役（肯塔基州）
zh.s: 1861年12月28日，美国内战期间，纳撒尼尔·福雷斯特上校率领200至300名邦联骑兵，在肯塔基州萨克拉门托包围并击败了伊莱·默里少校指挥的500名联邦军。双方伤亡数字说法不一，目击者称赞福雷斯特勇敢，他的上级也表扬了他的表现。

en.s: The Battle of Mount Zion Church was fought on December 28, 1861, in Boone County, near Mount Zion Church, during the American Civil War. The resulting Union victory here and elsewhere in central Missouri ended Confederate recruiting activities in the region and pushed conventional Confederate forces out of the area until the desperate fall 1864 invasion by General Sterling Price and his Missouri State Guard.

zh.s: 1861年12月28日，美国内战期间，双方在密苏里州布恩县锡安山教堂附近交战。联邦军获胜；这场胜利连同密苏里州中部其他战斗，终止了邦联军在当地的招募活动，并将常规邦联军逐出该地区，直到1864年秋斯特林·普赖斯率领密苏里州卫队入侵。

en.s: The Van Buren raid occurred in Crawford County, Arkansas, on December 28, 1862, during the American Civil War. After defeating Confederate forces led by Major General Thomas C. Hindman at the Battle of Prairie Grove on December 7, 1862, Union forces under Brigadiers General James G. Blunt and Francis J. Herron prepared for a raid against the Confederate positions at Van Buren and Fort Smith.

zh.s: 1862年12月28日，美国内战期间，联邦军在阿肯色州克劳福德县发动范布伦突袭。此前，詹姆斯·布朗特和弗朗西斯·赫伦率领的联邦军已在草原丛林战役中击败托马斯·欣德曼少将指挥的邦联军，并准备袭击邦联军在范布伦和史密斯堡的阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Egypt Station (December 28, 1864) was an engagement in Mississippi that took place during a successful Union cavalry raid during the American Civil War. A 3,500-man Union cavalry division under Brigadier General Benjamin Grierson defeated Confederate troops led by Franklin Gardner and Samuel J. Gholson. Grierson's raiding cavalry left Memphis, Tennessee on 21 December and first demolished a Confederate supply depot at Verona.

zh.s: 1864年12月28日，美国内战期间，内森尼尔·吉里森准将率领3500名联邦骑兵在密西西比州击败了富兰克林·加德纳和塞缪尔·戈尔森率领的邦联军。吉里森的骑兵此前于12月21日离开孟菲斯，并先在维罗纳摧毁了邦联军的补给仓库。

en.s: The Skeleton Cave massacre was the killing of Yavapai people by the US army on December 28th, 1872 in the Arizona Territory during the Yavapai wars.

zh.s: 1872年12月28日，美国军队在亚利桑那领地的骷髅洞杀害了亚瓦派人。这起事件发生在亚瓦派战争期间。

en.s: The Tay Bridge disaster occurred during a violent storm on 28 December 1879 when the first Tay Rail Bridge collapsed while a train was passing over it from Wormit to Dundee, killing all aboard. The bridge—designed by Sir Thomas Bouch—used lattice girders supported by iron piers, with cast iron columns and wrought iron cross-bracing. The piers were narrower and their cross-bracing was less extensive and robust than on previous similar designs by Bouch. Bouch had sought expert advice on "wind loading" when designing a proposed rail bridge over the Firth of Forth; as a result of that advice he had made no explicit allowance for wind loading in the design of the Tay Bridge.

zh.s: 1879年12月28日，一场猛烈风暴期间，首座泰铁路桥在列车从沃米特驶往邓迪、行经桥上时坍塌，车上人员全部遇难。大桥由托马斯·布奇爵士设计，采用铁制桥墩支撑的桁架结构，桥墩使用铸铁立柱并以锻铁交叉支撑。与布奇此前类似设计相比，这座桥的桥墩更窄，交叉支撑也更少、更不坚固。布奇在设计福斯湾铁路桥方案时曾就风荷载咨询专家；受建议影响，他没有在泰桥设计中明确考虑风荷载。

en.s: The Indian National Congress (INC), also known as the Congress Party, or simply the Congress, is a big tent political party in India. It is India's oldest existing political party and is widely regarded as one of the world's oldest continuously active political parties, outside Europe and North America. Founded on 28 December 1885, it was the first modern nationalist movement to emerge in the British Empire in Asia and Africa.

zh.s: 印度国民大会党于1885年12月28日成立。该党也称国大党，是印度现存历史最悠久的政党之一，也是亚非地区最早出现的现代民族主义运动。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1886 was the sixth general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on December 28, 1886, to elect the 90 Members of the 6th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Oliver Mowat, won a fifth consecutive term in government and an increased majority in the Legislature.

zh.s: 加拿大安大略省于1886年12月28日举行第六次大选，选出第六届立法议会的90名议员。奥利弗·莫瓦特领导的安大略自由党连续第五次赢得执政权，并扩大了议会多数。

en.s: The Tafilalt expedition was a large military expedition conducted by Sultan Moulay Hassan of Morocco in the region of Tafilalt in 1893 in the face of French Algerian expansionism. Moulay Hassan revitalized relations between the makhzan and the tribes and villages of the eastern and Saharan frontier lands. The expedition to the Tafilalt in 1893 was sent because the sultan feared that disorder there would provide an excuse for French intervention.

zh.s: 1893年，摩洛哥苏丹穆莱·哈桑为应对法国在阿尔及利亚的扩张，在塔菲拉尔特地区发动大规模军事远征。穆莱·哈桑借此恢复马赫赞政权与东部及撒哈拉边境地区部族和村庄的关系。苏丹担心当地动乱会成为法国干涉的借口，因此派兵前往塔菲拉尔特。

en.t: Wilhelm Röntgen publishes a paper detailing his discovery of a new type of radiation, which later will be known as x-rays
en.s: Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen (27 March 1845 – 10 February 1923) was a German experimental physicist who produced and detected electromagnetic radiation in a wavelength range known as X-rays (known as Röntgen rays in many languages). In 1901, Röntgen became the first recipient of the Nobel Prize in Physics "in recognition of the extraordinary services he has rendered by the discovery of the remarkable rays subsequently named after him."

zh.t: 伦琴发表介绍X射线发现的论文
zh.s: 1895年12月28日，德国物理学家威廉·康拉德·伦琴发表论文，详细介绍他发现的一种新型射线，后来这种射线被称为X射线。伦琴于1901年成为首位诺贝尔物理学奖得主。

en.s: A devastating earthquake occurred on 28 December 1908 in Sicily and Calabria, southern Italy, with a moment magnitude of 7.1 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme). The epicentre was in the Strait of Messina which separates Sicily from the Italian mainland. The cities of Messina and Reggio Calabria were nearly destroyed and around 120,000 people died, making it the deadliest earthquake in the history of Europe.

zh.s: 1908年12月28日，意大利南部西西里和卡拉布里亚发生里氏7.1级地震，最高烈度达麦加利烈度XI级（极端）。震中位于分隔西西里岛和意大利半岛的墨西拿海峡。墨西拿和雷焦卡拉布里亚两座城市几乎被夷为平地，约12万人遇难，是欧洲历史上死亡人数最多的地震。

en.s: The 1913 Argentine Primera División final was the match that determined the winner of 1913 season of Argentine Primera División. The final was contested by Racing and San Isidro, in order to decide a champion after both teams had finished tied on both, points (24 in 14 matches played) and goal difference (+36) at the end of the tournament. It was the 1st. league final contested by both clubs.

zh.s: 1913年12月28日，竞技俱乐部与圣伊西德罗俱乐部进行阿根廷甲级联赛决赛，争夺当季冠军。两队在常规赛结束时积分相同，均为14场24分，净胜球也同为+36。这是两队首次在联赛决赛中交手。

en.s: The Rand Rebellion (or Rand Revolt, or Second Rand Revolt) was an armed uprising of white miners in the Witwatersrand region of South Africa, in March 1922. Jimmy Green, a prominent politician in the Labour Party, was one of the leaders of the strike. Following a drop in the world price of gold from 130 shillings (£6 10s) a fine troy ounce in 1919 to 95s/oz (£4 15s) in December 1921, the companies tried to cut their operating costs by decreasing wages, and by weakening the colour bar to enable the promotion of cheaper black miners to skilled and supervisory positions.

zh.s: 兰德起义又称兰德暴动或第二次兰德暴动，是1922年3月南非威特沃特斯兰德地区白人矿工发动的武装起义。工党重要政治人物吉米·格林是罢工领导人之一。世界金价从1919年每金衡盎司130先令（6英镑10先令）跌至1921年12月的95先令（4英镑15先令）后，矿业公司试图降低运营成本，既削减工资，也放宽种族隔离限制，让成本较低的黑人矿工晋升至技术和监督岗位。

en.s: The Battle of Huizhou was fought between the 4th Army of Miao Peinan and the 11th Army of Chen Mingshu. Miao retreated to Huizhou after his defeat by Li Jishen at the Battle of Guangzhou. After his defeat, Miao retreated to his hometown of Wuhua, Guangdong. It was one of many internal conflicts within the Kuomintang in the aftermath of Chiang Kai-shek's successes in the Northern Expedition.

zh.s: 惠州战役于1927年12月28日开始，至1928年1月4日结束，交战双方是苗沛霖第四军与陈铭枢第十一军。苗沛霖在广州战役败给李济深后退至惠州，之后又退回广东五华老家。这场战役是北伐胜利后国民党内部多次冲突之一。
zh.n: 战役于1927年12月28日开始，至1928年1月4日结束。

en.s: The 1940 Copa Aldao was the final match to decide the winner of the Copa Aldao, the 13th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Uruguayan club Nacional and Argentine side Boca Juniors. The match was played at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo. With Boca Juniors winning 2–1, on 88 minutes Nacional striker Atilio García forced a draw.

zh.s: 1940年阿尔道杯决赛决定该赛事第13届冠军归属。比赛由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同组织，参赛队为乌拉圭民族队和阿根廷博卡青年队。比赛在蒙得维的亚世纪球场举行。博卡青年队以2比1取胜；第88分钟，民族队前锋阿蒂利奥·加西亚迫使比赛战平。

en.s: The Battle of the Pimple was part of the Markham and Ramu Valley – Finisterre Range campaign, which consisted of a number of battles fought by Australian and Japanese troops in Papua New Guinea in World War II. Fought on 27 and 28 December 1943, the battle took place as the Australians advanced towards the Japanese strong hold around Shaggy Ridge, and was a preliminary phase in their eventual capture of that position in January 1944. Supported by artillery, mortars, machine guns and fighter-bomber aircraft, the assault was made across a narrow frontage, which was usually not much wider than a single section.

zh.s: 1943年12月27日至28日，澳大利亚军队在新几内亚沙吉岭附近向日军据点推进，双方在皮姆普尔山丘交战。这次进攻得到炮兵、迫击炮、机枪和战斗轰炸机支援，是1944年1月最终攻占沙吉岭前的一次战斗。
zh.n: 战斗于1943年12月27日至28日进行。

en.t: Battle of the Bay of Biscay
en.s: The Battle of the Bay of Biscay or Operation Bernau, was a naval action that took place on 28 December 1943 during the Second World War during the Atlantic campaign. The engagement took place between two light cruisers of the Royal Navy and a force of destroyers and torpedo boats of the Kriegsmarine that had sailed to rendezvous with a blockade-runner and escort it to port.

zh.s: 1943年12月28日，第二次世界大战大西洋战役期间，英国皇家海军两艘轻巡洋舰与德国海军的一支驱逐舰和鱼雷艇编队在比斯开湾交战。德军舰艇当时正准备与一艘突破封锁的商船会合，并护送它进港。

en.s: The Battle of Ortona (20–28 December 1943) was fought between two battalions of elite German Fallschirmjäger (paratroops) from the German 1st Parachute Division under Generalleutnant Richard Heidrich, and assaulting Canadian troops from the 1st Canadian Infantry Division under Major General Christopher Vokes. It was the culmination of the fighting on the Adriatic front in Italy during "Bloody December".

zh.s: 1943年12月20日至28日，德国第一伞兵师的两个精锐伞兵营与克里斯托弗·沃克斯少将指挥的加拿大第一步兵师交战。奥托纳战役是意大利亚得里亚海战线“血腥十二月”战事的高潮。
zh.n: 战役于1943年12月28日结束。

en.s: Operation Hardtack was the name of a series of British Commando raids during the Second World War. The operation was conducted by No. 10 (Inter-Allied) Commando, No. 12 Commando and the Special Boat Service, and took place on the Channel Islands and the northern coast of France in December 1943. Most of the raids consisted of ten men of various ranks, carried by Motor Torpedo Boats and dories, except for one operation, which was an airborne landing.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “坚韧行动”是二战期间一系列英国突击队袭击的代号，由第10（盟军）突击队、第12突击队和特别舟艇部队执行，于1943年12月在海峡群岛和法国北部海岸展开。多数袭击队由10名不同军衔的人员组成，乘鱼雷快艇和小艇抵达；其中一次则采用空降方式。

en.s: The Battle of Garfagnana (Italian: Battaglia della Garfagnana), known to the Germans as Operation Winter Storm (Unternehmen Wintergewitter) and nicknamed the "Christmas Offensive" (Italian: Offensiva di Natale), was a successful Axis offensive against American forces on the western sector of the Gothic Line during World War II. It took place in December 1944 in the north Tuscan Apennines, near Massa and Lucca.

zh.s: 加尔法尼亚纳战役又称德军“冬季风暴行动”，绰号“圣诞攻势”，是二战期间轴心国在哥特防线西段对美军发动的一次成功攻势。战斗于1944年12月在托斯卡纳北部亚平宁山脉、马萨和卢卡附近展开。

en.s: The disappearance of a Douglas DC-3 airliner, registered NC16002, occurred on the night of 28 December 1948 near the end of a scheduled flight from San Juan, Puerto Rico, to Miami, Florida. The aircraft carried 29 passengers and three crew members. No probable cause for the loss was determined by the official investigation and it remains unsolved.

zh.s: 1948年12月28日晚，航空运输公司一架注册号为NC16002的道格拉斯DC-3客机在圣胡安飞往迈阿密的定期航班接近尾声时失踪。机上有29名乘客和3名机组人员。官方调查未能确定失事原因，事件至今未解。

en.s: The Battles of the Sinai refer to a series of military engagements between the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and the Egyptian Army fought in the Sinai Peninsula from December 28, 1948 to January 2, 1949, as part of the Israeli Operation Horev. The IDF's Southern Command, under Yigal Allon, concentrated forces to push into the Sinai following their success in the Battle of Bir 'Asluj and the Battle of 'Auja.

zh.s: 1948年12月28日至1949年1月2日，以色列国防军与埃及军队在西奈半岛发生一系列战斗，属于以军“霍雷夫行动”的一部分。南方司令部司令伊加尔·阿隆在贝尔阿斯卢杰和奥贾战役取胜后，集结部队向西奈推进。

en.s: Operation Hisul (Hebrew: חיסול מבצע, Mivtza Hisul, lit. Operation Liquidation) was a failed Israeli attempt to dissolve the Egyptian pocket of al-Faluja on the night of 28 December during Operation Horev. The operation was the second-worst loss suffered by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) in a single engagement behind the Kfar Etzion massacre in May up until that point.

zh.s: 1948年12月28日晚，第一次中东战争期间，以色列军队发动希苏尔行动，试图攻破埃及军队在法卢贾的包围圈，但未成功。这是截至当时以色列国防军单场交战伤亡最惨重的行动之一，仅次于5月发生的卡法尔埃齐翁大屠杀。

en.s: The 1958 NFL Championship Game was the 26th NFL championship game, played on December 28 at Yankee Stadium in New York City. It was the first NFL game to be decided in sudden death overtime. The Baltimore Colts won their first championship in franchise history over the New York Giants 23–17 in what soon became widely known as "the Greatest Game Ever Played".

zh.s: 1958年12月28日，第26届NFL总冠军赛在纽约洋基体育场举行。巴尔的摩小马队以23比17击败纽约巨人队，首次夺得队史总冠军。这也是NFL首场通过突然死亡加时赛决出胜负的比赛，后来被誉为“最伟大的比赛”。

en.s: The Battle of Santa Clara was a series of events in late December 1958 that led to the capture of the Cuban city of Santa Clara by rebel forces under the command of Che Guevara at the end of the Cuban Revolution. A decisive victory for the rebels who fought against the regime of General Fulgencio Batista, the battle culminated in the Triumph of the Revolution.

zh.s: 1958年12月28日，切·格瓦拉率领的游击队从古巴沿海港口卡伊巴连出发，沿通往卡马华尼的公路向圣克拉拉进发。卡伊巴连在一天内被攻占，卡马华尼驻军也未交战便弃守；格瓦拉的队伍黄昏时抵达圣克拉拉郊外的大学。

en.s: Operation Grandslam was an offensive undertaken by United Nations peacekeeping forces from 28 December 1962 to 15 January 1963 against the forces of the State of Katanga, a secessionist state rebelling against the Republic of the Congo (now the Democratic Republic of the Congo) in Central Africa. The conflict ended with the defeat of the State of Katanga and its subsequent dissolution.

zh.s: 联合国维和部队于1962年12月28日至1963年1月15日对加丹加国发动“大满贯行动”，打击这个在中部非洲脱离刚果共和国、宣布独立的分离政权。行动以加丹加国战败及随后解体告终。
zh.n: 行动于1962年12月28日开始，持续至1963年1月15日。

en.s: The Battle of Binh Gia (Vietnamese: Trận Bình Giã), which was part of a larger communist campaign, was conducted by the Viet Cong from December 28, 1964, to January 1, 1965, during the Vietnam War in Bình Giã. The battle took place in Phước Tuy Province (now part of Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu Province), South Vietnam. The year of 1964 marked a decisive turning point in the Vietnam War. Following the ousting of President Ngô Đình Diệm in 1963, South Vietnam's top army generals continued to vie with each other for control of the country’s military-dominated government instead of combating the emerging forces of the National Liberation Front, also known as the Viet Cong.

zh.s: 平嘉战役（越南语：Trận Bình Giã）是更大规模共产主义攻势的一部分，由越共在越南战争期间于1964年12月28日至1965年1月1日在平嘉一带发动。战场位于南越福绥省（今巴地头顿省）。1964年是越南战争的关键转折点：吴廷琰总统于1963年被推翻后，南越高级军官忙于争夺由军方主导的政府控制权，没有集中力量对付正在崛起的民族解放阵线（又称越共）。

en.s: The 1964 Italian presidential election was held in Italy from 16 to 28 December 1964, following the resignation of President Antonio Segni on 6 December 1964 due to health problems. Only members of Parliament and regional delegates were entitled to vote, most of these electors having been elected in the 1963 general election.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 意大利于1964年12月16日至28日举行总统选举，此次选举是在总统安东尼奥·塞尼因健康原因于12月6日辞职后进行的。只有议员和大区代表有权投票。经过21轮投票，朱塞佩·萨拉盖特当选总统。
zh.n: 选举于1964年12月16日至28日举行。

en.s: Operation Cauldron was launched by the Rhodesian Security Forces in response to an incursion by ZIPRA insurgents on 28 December 1967. Despite the death or capture of 77 out of 79 men, ZAPU, from its base in the Zambian capital, Lusaka, did not regard the incursion as a failure; on the contrary, its leaders were pleased that they had inflicted some casualties on the Rhodesian African Rifles.

zh.s: 1967年12月28日，罗得西亚安全部队为应对ZIPRA武装人员越境，发起“大锅行动”。79名越境人员中有77人被击毙或俘虏。尽管损失惨重，设在赞比亚首都卢萨卡的津巴布韦非洲人民联盟领导人仍认为行动并非失败，因为他们认为武装人员给罗得西亚非洲步枪团造成了一些伤亡。

en.s: The October Crisis (French: Crise d'Octobre) was a chain of political events in Canada that started in October 1970 when members of the Front de libération du Québec (FLQ) kidnapped the provincial Labour Minister Pierre Laporte and British diplomat James Cross from his Montreal residence. These events saw Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau invoking the War Measures Act for the first time in Canadian history during peacetime.

zh.s: 1970年12月28日，魁北克省圣吕克仍在逃的陈耶尔小组3名成员——保罗·罗斯、雅克·罗斯和弗朗西斯·西马尔——被发现藏在一处乡间农场的隧道里并遭逮捕。隧道长约6米，3人后来被控绑架并杀害皮埃尔·拉波特。

en.s: United Airlines Flight 173 was a scheduled flight from John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City to Portland International Airport in Portland, Oregon, with a scheduled stop in Denver, Colorado. On December 28, 1978, the McDonnell Douglas DC-8-61 operating the flight ran out of fuel while troubleshooting a landing gear problem and crashed in a suburban Portland neighborhood near NE 157th Avenue and East Burnside Street, killing 10 people on board.

en.s: Indirect parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 28 December 1981. On 11 and 18 October voters elected members of the 169 Municipal Assemblies. A total of 6,097,139 votes were cast in the first round (11 October) and in the second round (18 October), giving a turnout of 97% in the first round and 93.6% in the second. The elected members of the Municipal Assemblies then elected the 499 members of the National Assembly. Candidates were selected by a commission composed of the Communist Party, the Young Communist League or mass organisations.

zh.t: 古巴1981年全国人民政权代表大会选举
zh.s: 古巴于1981年12月28日间接选举全国人民政权代表大会成员。169个市级议会的代表此前在10月11日和18日两轮投票中选出，共有6,097,139张选票；两轮投票率分别为97%和93.6%。随后，市级议会代表选出499名全国人民政权代表大会代表。候选人由共产党、共青团或群众组织组成的委员会遴选。

en.s: General elections were held in India on 24, 27 and 28 December 1984, shortly after the assassination of prime minister, Indira Gandhi. Voting was delayed in Assam and Punjab until 1985 due to ongoing insurgency. The elections were a landslide victory for the Indian National Congress (Indira) of Rajiv Gandhi (son of Indira Gandhi), which won 404 of the 514 seats elected in 1984 and a further 10 in the delayed elections.

zh.s: 印度于1984年12月24日、27日和28日举行大选。英迪拉·甘地遇刺后，阿萨姆邦和旁遮普邦因叛乱局势延至1985年投票。拉吉夫·甘地领导的印度国民大会党（英迪拉派）大胜，在1984年选出的514个席位中赢得404席，另在延期选举中赢得10席。

en.s: The 1989 Newcastle earthquake was an intraplate earthquake that occurred in Newcastle, New South Wales, on Thursday 28 December. The shock measured 5.6 on the Richter scale and was one of Australia's most serious natural disasters, killing 13 people and injuring more than 160. The damage bill has been estimated at A$4 billion (or $9.5 billion in 2022, adjusted for inflation), including an insured loss of about $1 billion (or $2.4 billion in 2022, adjusted for inflation).

en.t: Starrcade '92: Battlebowl – The Lethal Lottery II
en.s: Starrcade '92: Battlebowl – The Lethal Lottery II was the 10th annual Starrcade professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The show's focus was the second-ever "Lethal Lottery" / "Battle Bowl" tournament, where randomly paired tag teams competed for a spot in the Battle Bowl battle royal at the end of the night.

en.s: The Battle of Khankala was a failed attempt by the Chechen separatists to attack the Russian military base at Khankala using heavy weapons on 28 December 1994. Khankala is a former Soviet military base and airstrip at the eastern outskirts of Grozny, also overtaking the main Rostov-Baku highway and cutting direct access into the Chechen capital of Grozny from the town of Argun.

zh.s: 1994年12月28日，车臣分离主义武装试图使用重型武器攻击汉卡拉的俄罗斯军事基地，但行动失败。汉卡拉原为苏联军事基地和机场，位于格罗兹尼东郊，控制罗斯托夫—巴库公路，并可切断从阿尔贡通往车臣首府格罗兹尼的直接通道。

en.s: The 1994 offshore Sanriku earthquake (Japanese: 三陸はるか沖地震 Sanriku Haruka Okijishin) occurred on December 28, 1994, at 12:19 UTC (21:19 JST). This was a magnitude Mw 7.7 earthquake with epicenter located in the Pacific Ocean at about 180 km east of Hachinohe, Aomori (haruka-oki means "far offshore"). The intensity reached shindo 6 in Hachinohe, Aomori, about 187.6 km from epicenter.

zh.s: 1994年12月28日12时19分（UTC；日本时间21时19分），三陆近海发生矩震级7.7级地震，震中位于青森县八户市以东约180公里的太平洋海域。八户观测到日本气象厅震度6级；该市距震中约187.6公里。

en.s: Starrcade (1997) was the fifteenth annual Starrcade professional wrestling pay-per-view event. It was the tenth Starrcade event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW), and it took place on December 28, 1997 from the MCI Center in Washington, D.C. It featured the ongoing storyline between WCW and the New World Order (nWo) organization. The main event was between Hollywood Hogan and Sting for the World Heavyweight Championship, with Hogan representing the nWo and Sting representing World Championship Wrestling. The match culminated a year-long buildup of their feud. The match ended in controversy over the referee's pinfall count, and their feud continued after the event surrounding this.

zh.s: 1997年Starrcade是第15届年度职业摔角付费赛事，也是世界冠军摔角（WCW）制作的第10届Starrcade，于1997年12月28日在华盛顿特区MCI中心举行。赛事延续了WCW与新世界秩序（nWo）组织之间的剧情。主赛由代表nWo的Hollywood Hogan对阵代表WCW的Sting，争夺世界重量级冠军。这场比赛是两人长达一年恩怨剧情的高潮，但裁判压制计数引发争议，双方的恩怨在赛后仍继续发展。

en.s: The Shenzhen Metro (Chinese: 深圳地铁) is the rapid transit system of the city of Shenzhen in Guangdong Province, China. The newest lines and extensions which opened on 28 June 2026 put the network at 642 kilometres (399 miles) of trackage. It currently operates on 17 lines with 421 stations. Despite having only opened on 28 December 2004, the Shenzhen Metro is the 5th longest metro system in the world.
en.n: The grand opening of the Shenzhen Metro system occurred at 5:00 pm on Tuesday, December 28, 2004.

zh.s: 深圳地铁于2004年12月28日正式开通，是深圳市的城市轨道交通系统。2026年6月，新线路和延长线投入运营后，全网里程达到642公里，共有17条线路和421座车站。

en.t: Opening of Wuhan Yangtze River Tunnel
en.s: The Wuhan Yangtze River Tunnel (also known as the Wuhan Changjiang Tunnel), is the first tunnel under the Yangtze River. Trial operation commenced on December 28, 2008. It takes about seven minutes to cross the Yangtze River by car using the tunnel. The tunnel connects Hankou and Wuchang districts in the city of Wuhan. Construction commenced in 2004. Its length is 3,630 meters.

zh.s: 武汉长江隧道于2008年12月28日开始试运营，是首条穿越长江的隧道。驾车通过隧道约需7分钟。隧道长3630米，连接武汉市汉口和武昌。工程于2004年开工。

en.s: 2009 Karachi bombing or Ashura attack took place on 28 December 2009 inside a Shi'ite procession commemorating the day of Ashura, at Muhammad Ali Jinnah Road, Karachi. Ashura is the holiest of days for followers of Shia Islam and marks the anniversary of the death of Hussain, grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, who was killed at the battle of Karbala in 680. At least 30 people were initially reported to have been killed, later figures revealed even more deaths while dozens were left injured in the wake of the attack. The attacker marched amongst the procession with tens of thousands of people attending the march.

zh.s: 2009年卡拉奇爆炸案（又称阿舒拉袭击）于2009年12月28日发生在卡拉奇穆罕默德·阿里·真纳路的一支什叶派阿舒拉纪念游行队伍中。阿舒拉日是什叶派最神圣的日子，用以纪念伊斯兰先知穆罕默德之孙侯赛因于680年在卡尔巴拉战役中遇害。最初报道称至少30人死亡；后续数字显示死亡人数更多，另有数十人受伤。袭击者混在数万名游行者中。

en.s: The Baneh clash was a military confrontation between Iranian security forces belonging to the Basij, the paramilitary branch of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK) militants which occurred on December 28, 2011 According to Iranian media outlets Fars News and Press TV at least five people were killed during the clash, including one Basiji and four members of the PJAK, adding that several PJAK members had been injured.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia on 28 December 2014 and 11 January 2015, the sixth such elections since independence in 1991. With only four candidates taking part, the elections had the lowest number of competitors since 1997. As no candidate received 50% of the vote in the first round in December 2014, a run-off took place in January 2015 between the two candidates with the most votes; incumbent President Ivo Josipović and Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović.

zh.s: 克罗地亚总统选举首轮于2014年12月28日举行，次轮于2015年1月11日进行。这是克罗地亚1991年独立以来第六次总统选举，只有4名候选人参选，是1997年以来人数最少的一次。首轮无人得票过半，现任总统伊沃·约西波维奇与科琳达·格拉巴尔-基塔罗维奇进入次轮。

en.s: Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501 was a scheduled international passenger flight operated by Indonesia AirAsia from Surabaya, Indonesia, to Singapore. On 28 December 2014, the Airbus A320 flying the route crashed into the Java Sea, killing all 162 of the people on board. When search operations ended in March 2015, only 116 bodies had been recovered. As of 2026, this is the only fatal accident involving AirAsia and its affiliates.

zh.s: 2014年12月28日，印尼亚航8501号班机从印尼泗水飞往新加坡途中坠入爪哇海，机上162人全部遇难。搜救行动于2015年3月结束时，仅找到116具遗体。

en.t: Opening of Kunming South railway station
en.s: Kunming South railway station is the main high-speed rail station of the Kunming metropolitan area. It is the western terminus of the Nanning–Kunming High-Speed Railway and the Shanghai–Kunming High-Speed Railway. The station is located in the Chenggong District of the City of Kunming, the capital of Yunnan Province. It was put into operation simultaneously with the two high-speed mainlines it serves, after five years of construction.

en.s: On 28 December 2019, a suicide truck bomber killed at least 85 people at the Ex-Control Afgoye police checkpoint in Mogadishu, Somalia. More than 140 others were wounded and, as of 31 December, 12 people remained missing. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the attack on 30 December. The attack was the deadliest in Somalia since the 14 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings, which killed 587 people.

zh.s: 2019年12月28日，一名自杀式卡车炸弹袭击者在索马里摩加迪沙的阿夫戈耶检查站引爆炸弹，造成至少85人死亡、140多人受伤。截至12月31日，仍有12人失踪。青年党于12月30日宣称对此负责。这是索马里自2017年10月造成587人死亡的摩加迪沙爆炸案以来，伤亡最惨重的一次袭击。
